Name: Sam Short Hair for Content Patcher
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod is an adaptation of jessicasoosh's Sam short hair mod and thalabee's great and cool haircut mod for content patcher. Content patcher mods are better for many reasons. See the dangers of using an XNB mod here: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods[/url]

This mod edits the sprite and portrait of Sam to give him shorter hair.

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher 1.13.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!
